tender.title: Apply for Things - ref C20345
tender.description:
This Contract establishes the overarching terms 
under which the Supplier shall provide flexible 
and scalable resource capacity, digital delivery, 
development, live service support and related 
services in support of the Buyer's Apply for 
Things product family and associated services. 
The purpose of this Contract is to secure access 
to a pool of suitably skilled resources that can 
be mobilised and demobilised at pace, with 
minimal lead time, in response to evolving 
programme requirements, operational demand 
and Ministerial priorities, while maintaining 
service continuity, quality and compliance. 
The Services shall support the continued 
delivery, development, operation, improvement 
and live support of the Apply for Things products 
and associated services, including public-facing 
services and services used in internal 
caseworking operations. This includes support 
for technical delivery teams responsible for new 
functionality and continuous improvement, 
together with live service support for incident 
management and production environments. 
The Supplier shall work collaboratively with the 
Buyer to support the Buyer's vision and 
objectives for the Apply for Things product 
family and wider product ecosystem, including 
by enabling flexible capacity management, 
supporting rapid design, development and 
deployment, contributing to service and 
architectural improvement, maintaining stable 
and highly available services, and supporting 
relevant transition and migration activity. 
The Order Form and its schedules set out the 
contractual baseline for the Services. The 
detailed scope, Deliverables, milestones, 
dependencies, implementation activities, 
service levels and acceptance criteria for each 
work package shall be set out in the relevant 
Statement of Work agreed under this Contract.
